design.relation_state: [u8; 64] physical state (one byte/square: none / A_N / A_B / A_R / A_Q / D / C + piece-color bit); perspective-independent; rows derived at apply time with the child's king context
design.per_edge: child attack-map pair (2 board passes) + 64-square state recompute + parent-vs-child state diff + FT add/sub of CHANGED rows only (real weights)
design.king_move: rare path: mover's perspective rebuilt from base + all child relation rows; other perspective still diffed

parity_gates.unit_tests: s11b4a_attack_map_bitwise_exact / s11b4a_state_rows_match_frozen_emitter (static + 1200 playout positions) / s11b4a_diff_chain_equals_full_refresh (10 games x 120 plies) — ALL PASS

cost_gate.edge_distribution: deterministic random legal playouts + periodic corpus-seed restarts (64 FENs from the frozen 10k corpus)

context.note: The B4 delta cost (448 ns/edge) replaces the B2 fresh eval relation work (~21.8us of scan+row adds per eval) at push time instead of eval time; combined with eval = plain dense-from-accumulator (~1.0us), the projected hybrid eval cost is back to E3-class.
context.projection_rationale: E3 ~160-170k NPS on this machine (~6us/node). B4 adds ~0.45us/edge (only on push_child, roughly one per node) => projected NPS ratio ~0.85-0.92; the B4-B search integration + paired NPS measurement decides against the frozen 0.90/0.80 gates.

verdict: S11-B4-A PASS: incremental relation delta is correct (bitwise) and costs ~448 ns/median per search edge — 3.3x under the 1500 ns gate, 2.2x under the ideal bar. B4-B (search integration + paired NPS) is GO.
